#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#define ll long long
#define F(i, l, r) for (int i = l; i <= r; i++)
using namespace std;
const int P = 998244353, mod = 1e9 + 7, B = 1e6;
int m(ll d) { return (d % P + P) % P; }
ll n, cnt, s[7];
int ans;
vector<int> p[7];
void dfs0(int d, ll v) {
	cnt++, p[d].push_back(m(cnt - v));
	if (d < 6) F(i, 0, 9) dfs0(d + 1, v * 10 + i);
}
int calc(int id, int f) {
	int ps = lower_bound(p[id].begin(), p[id].end(), P - f) - p[id].begin();
	return ((ll)f * p[id].size() + s[id] - (ll)P * (p[id].size() - ps)) % mod;
}
void dfs1(int d, ll v) {
	if (v > n) return;
	if (d >= 1) {
		if (v * B > n / 10 && v * B + B - 1 <= n) {
			int t = 1;
			F(i, 0, 6) (ans += calc(i, m(cnt - v * t))) %= mod, t *= 10;
			F(i, 0, 6) cnt += p[i].size();
			return;
		}
		(ans += m(++cnt - v)) %= mod;
	}
	F(i, !d, 9) dfs1(d + 1, v * 10 + i);
}
int main() {
	scanf("%lld", &n), dfs0(0, 0);
	F(i, 0, 6) {
		sort(p[i].begin(), p[i].end());
		F(j, 0, p[i].size() - 1) s[i] += p[i][j];
	}
	cnt = 0, dfs1(0, 0), printf("%d\n", ans);
	return 0;
}
